column1: # Every IGNORE must carry a justification and should be re-reviewed when the
# frontend toolchain or nginx config changes. Anything not listed keeps the
# scan's default behavior (WARN, with fail_action failing on FAILs).
# Re-reviewed in phase 2 Wave 4 (QA) when the integration API was added to the
# scan (.zap/integration-seed.py): all four stay justified. 10015 and 10096
# concern static assets / the bundle; the API's own answers (JSON, 401s of
# /api/integration/v1, the token and enrolment endpoints) send Cache-Control:
# no-store and carry no epoch timestamps, and 10027/10109 never match JSON.
# No IGNORE was added for the integration routes.

column3: (Re-examine Cache-control Directives) Static assets are served by nginx with build-hashed filenames; caching them is intended. API responses set their own cache headers.
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments) Matches bundler-generated comments in the minified Vite/React vendor bundle, not MoDocument source comments.
(Timestamp Disclosure - Unix) False positive on build-hashed asset names and numeric constants in the minified bundle.
(Modern Web Application) Informational only: flags that the SPA uses client-side routing. Not a vulnerability.
